kalyāṇamitta.cp: masc. a good companion; honest friend.
kalyāṇamitta.p: [Kalyāṇa+mitta] (pu) CL=7 (1) A good friend; A friend who is full of good qualities such as precepts. (Ti) One who has a good friend (means has good deeds such as precepts).
